schema.name: game_tasks
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE game_tasks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scope TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT, preview_boot TEXT, expires_at INTEGER, approval_id TEXT, approval_at INTEGER)

schema.name: game_intents
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE game_intents(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES game_tasks(id), idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('recorded','accepted','unknown','completed')), action_id TEXT, acceptance TEXT, terminal TEXT)

schema.name: one_pending_game_intent
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_pending_game_intent ON game_intents((1)) WHERE state IN ('recorded','accepted','unknown')

schema.name: game_gate
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE game_gate(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), intent_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL)
